name: Oanarina Archi Tool
subtitle: Architecture, CAD and BIM
description:
Oanarina Archi Tool is a native Mac workspace for architectural drawing, 3D modeling and building information modeling. Draw with precise coordinates, snaps and familiar command aliases. Build projects with levels, walls, doors, windows, floors, roofs, stairs and rooms, then arrange sheets and export drawings or schedules.

Work in 2D and 3D, edit materials, render views, and exchange models using implemented formats including DXF, IFC, OBJ, STL and GLB. Save projects in the native .archi format. Automate work through the built-in JavaScript console and opt-in local agent API.

Core drawing and modeling work offline. Online lookups and a configured AI provider require a connection. Select project folders to access linked resources and multi-file exports in the sandboxed Mac App Store edition. Standalone command-line MCP and Python tooling are available in the website edition.
reviewNotes: Native macOS application for macOS 14 or later, with Apple silicon and Intel support. No login is required for local CAD/BIM work. Open the bundled Cedar House from the start screen to inspect a sample project. File > Allow Project Folder Access selects a project folder for linked assets, backups and batch exports. Settings > Agents enables the opt-in token-protected loopback server. Online AI is optional and uses the user's own configured provider; core modeling does not require an AI service. The standalone CLI/Python tools are available in the website edition.
remainingBeforeSubmission: Approve use of the distribution signing key in macOS and complete signed-package verification
Sign into App Store Connect and check for an existing app record before creating a new macOS record
Resolve GPL/App Store distribution rights and terms before submission
Publish an accurate app privacy policy and complete the data-collection questionnaire
Supply current macOS screenshots and complete age-rating, content-rights and export-compliance answers
Choose the store price and availability in App Store Connect
Validate the uploaded build with Apple's servers and submit for review
